verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own docs describe a sandbox reached with test keys, in which payments, transfers, and webhooks are simulated. Live keys are a separate step for real payments, which keeps testing away from production. The evidence is a single first-party sentence, though. Missing for 10: detailed sandbox docs (test cards/accounts, sandbox endpoints, data isolation guarantees), any statement of which features the sandbox does or does not cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox, then switch to live keys and start accepting real payments.
